messages:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — we’ve got the users schema migration tonight 02:00-03:30 PT. Who’s owning deploy and post-migration smoke checks? I’ll be on the night crew until 04:00.
Samir Patel: I can own the deploy part and the canary shift. plan: canary -> 10% traffic 02:05, 50% 02:20, 100% 02:40. I’ll watch replica lag.
Chris Nguyen: I’ll do smoke queries and data sanity. Quick checks: replication lag < 30s, backfill throughput <= 200 r/s, dual-write error rate < 0.5%.
Tina Zhao: I can be on rollback readiness and will keep the rollback scripts ready in case we see errors. rollback procedure is in ops runbook.
Maria Lopez: Thanks. @Samir, add a short checklist to the thread: pre-cutover read replicas, disable scheduled jobs, set maintenance header. Also ensure alerting runbook is set in PagerDuty.
Samir Patel: Added checklist to the deploy doc and pushed a small change: `scripts/dualsafe_cutover.sh` — includes pause/resume hook. Command to kick off canary: `./dualsafe_cutover.sh --env prod --mode canary --percent 10`
deploy-bot: Deployment slot reserved: prod-slot-17 for 02:00-04:00 PT. Canary prowler configured.
Chris Nguyen: Smoke queries I’ll run right after 10% cut:```sql
-- sanity
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE migrated = false LIMIT 1;
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id IS NULL LIMIT 1;
```If anything spikes I’ll post results here.
Tina Zhao: Rollback checklist: 1) Pause incoming writes via API flag 2) Switch traffic to backup model 3) Re-enable old write path `db.writer_v1` 4) Run `scripts/undo_migration.sh` (dry-run first). I have dry-run tested on staging.
Maria Lopez: One more ask — can someone own monitoring for KV cache thrash? last time we saw CPU bump after backfill. @oncall-ops?
oncall-ops: I’ll monitor infra dashboards and head off any CPU/network hotspots. I’ll escalate to infra if CPU > 80% for > 2m.
Samir Patel: I’ll throttle backfills if we hit thresholds: `BACKFILL_RATE=100` until healthy. I’ll also keep an eye on the job queue.
Chris Nguyen: If smoke OK at 02:50, we proceed with full cutover. If not, rollback within the 30min window.
Maria Lopez: Great. Summary: Owners: Samir (deploy), Chris (smoke), Tina (rollback), oncall-ops (infra). Canary schedule + scripts confirmed. We’ll post final "starting" ping ~01:55 PT. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Roger — I’ll post the start ping and watch the canary.
Tina Zhao: I’ll be on standby.
Maria Lopez: Closing loop — thanks team, see you tonight.
